name: Master of Arms
description: Hit enemies with your Attacks to gain a stack of Attack Speed and Mana Regen.

name: Eagle Eye
description: Replace your next 4 Attacks with empowered arrows that travel further and deal bonus Physical Damage based on your Basic Attack Damage. These Attacks can Critically Strike and trigger item effects.

name: Heavenly Banner
description: Call down a sacred banner that deals Physical Damage to enemies in the area and grant you Attack Speed for a duration. Leave a banner that grants you and allies Attack Speed while nearby.

name: Iaijutsu
description: Dash forward, dealing Physical Damage and passing through enemies. At the end of the dash, swing your blade in a circle, dealing Physical Damage again. Enemy gods hit by both attacks are Stunned.

name: Mounted Archery
description: Leap onto your horse and charge forward. While mounted, you are CC Immune and can aim separately from your horse. Fire to launch an arrow at every enemy god in a cone, dealing Physical Damage and Slowing them.

name: Hachiman Basic Attack
description: Fire a projectile that deals Physical Damage to the first enemy hit.
